summary.pathogen: Acinetobacter baumannii (WHO critical; HELD-OUT, not in panel)
summary.verdict: HELD-OUT north-star demonstration: from Acinetobacter baumannii's GENOME ALONE (a WHO critical-priority pathogen NEVER used to build the method — de-novo CarveMe GEM), the substrate produces a safe target shortlist in minutes and yields 24 novel safe predictions (essential + chokepoint + host-non-homologous), excluding 38 host-toxic genes by construction. **17/24 (70%) land in the CANONICAL antibacterial target landscape** (cell-wall mur*/mraY, isoprenoid isp*/dxr, CoA coa*, folate/riboflavin/thiamine/menaquinone): ['coaBC', 'coaD', 'coaE', 'coaX', 'dxr', 'dxs', 'ispD', 'ispE', 'ispF', 'ispG', 'mraY', 'murA', 'murB', 'murF', 'murG', 'thiE', 'thiL']. So the method reconstructs the established antibacterial target biology on a genuinely HELD-OUT pathogen — the north-star 'new pathogen genome -> credible safe targets within minutes' claim, demonstrated on an organism it had never seen. SCOPE: FBA-predicted essentiality (experimental check = VALIDATE Tier 0); de-novo GEM (default medium); hypotheses, not validated targets; not wet-lab.
